name: hanji
description: Read and edit Word, PowerPoint, Excel and Hancom files (docx, pptx, xlsx, hwpx) as text, keeping everything the text does not show

interface.shortDescription: Office files (docx, pptx, xlsx, hwpx) as editable text
interface.longDescription: Open a Word, PowerPoint, Excel or Hancom (hwpx) file, read it as text, edit it by exact spans or range operations, and export it with its formatting, pictures and comments kept. Macros and remote content are removed on open; comments, hidden text and metadata are surfaced before export.
